scope: All native commands; NES absolute CPU cycles, VGM original sample timestamps. Portable note extraction is an observer, not the independent reference.

digital.scope: Six FM channel values and both DAC pins after every internal clock; independent GME VGM decode, same documented bus write serialization. PSG and analog filtering are separate.

vgmBus.scope: Logical VGM commands retain their original sample timestamps. FM port bytes use the reference buffered-write policy; original CPU sub-sample timing is unavailable.
